glossYue: 普通字體免費。花體字要額外五十蚊。
say: A plain font is free. A script font is fifty dollars extra.

speaker: gus
text: Plain is fine. Can I check the engraving text before you cut it?
glossYue: 普通字體就得。刻之前我可唔可以核對段字？
say: Plain is fine. Can I check the engraving text before you cut it?

speaker: ida
text: Of course. Please sign this form, and it'll be ready in three days.
glossYue: 當然可以。請簽呢張表，三日後可以取。
say: Of course. Please sign this form, and it'll be ready in three days.

speaker: tom
text: Hi. I have a bad headache and a high fever. What medicine can I take?
glossYue: 你好。我頭痛又高燒。我可以食咩藥？
say: Hi. I have a bad headache and a high fever. What medicine can I take?

speaker: suki
text: This tablet is good for both the fever and the headache. Do you have allergies?
glossYue: 呢種藥對發燒同頭痛都有用。你有冇敏感？
say: This tablet is good for both the fever and the headache. Do you have allergies?

speaker: tom
text: No, I don't have any allergies. How many times a day should I take this?
glossYue: 我冇敏感。一日應該食幾多次？
say: No, I don't have any allergies. How many times a day should I take this?

speaker: suki
text: Three times a day, after meals. Don't take more than six tablets each single day.
glossYue: 一日三次，食完飯先食。一日唔好多過六粒。
say: Three times a day, after meals. Don't take more than six tablets each single day.

speaker: tom
text: Will this one tablet make me feel drowsy? I still have to drive home later.
glossYue: 呢粒會唔會令人好眼瞓？我遲啲要揸車返屋企。
say: Will this one tablet make me feel drowsy? I still have to drive home later.

speaker: suki
text: Yes. If you must drive, take this other tablet. It won't make you sleepy.
glossYue: 會。如果你要揸車，食呢種。佢唔會令人眼瞓。
say: Yes. If you must drive, take this other tablet. It won't make you sleepy.

speaker: tom
text: Great news indeed. Do I need a written prescription before taking this other tablet?
glossYue: 好消息。食呢種之前使唔使醫生處方？
say: Great news indeed. Do I need a written prescription before taking this other tablet?

speaker: suki
text: No prescription needed. If the fever lasts over three days, see one doctor soon.
glossYue: 唔使處方。如果發燒超過三日，就要睇醫生。
say: No prescription needed. If the fever lasts over three days, see one doctor soon.

speaker: tom
text: Hi Ray, I'm running about five minutes late for the taxi. Can you still wait?
glossYue: Ray，我叫的士遲咗大約五分鐘。你可唔可以等埋？
say: Hi Ray, I'm running about five minutes late for the taxi. Can you still wait?

speaker: ray
text: No problem. I'll still wait at the pick-up point beside the main front door.
glossYue: 冇問題。我會喺大門旁邊嘅上車點等你。
say: No problem. I'll still wait at the pick-up point beside the main front door.

speaker: tom
text: Thanks a lot. What's your plate number, and which colour car should I look for?
glossYue: 多謝。你車牌幾多，我要搵咩顏色嘅車？
say: Thanks a lot. What's your plate number, and which colour car should I look for?

speaker: ray
text: The plate number is MX 42 17, and the car is a white Toyota beside that front door.
glossYue: 車牌係 MX 42 17，白色豐田，就喺大門旁邊。
say: The plate number is MX 42 17, and the car is a white Toyota beside that front door.

speaker: tom
text: Thanks. Can we change the destination to the airport instead of the hotel lobby please?
glossYue: 多謝。可唔可以將目的地由酒店大堂改去機場？
say: Thanks. Can we change the destination to the airport instead of the hotel lobby please?

speaker: ray
text: Sure. Just change the destination in the app and the new fare will update automatically.
glossYue: 可以。你喺應用程式改目的地，新車費會自動更新。
say: Sure. Just change the destination in the app and the new fare will update automatically.

speaker: tom
text: Can I pay by card when we arrive, and will I get a receipt after?
glossYue: 到埗可唔可以用卡畀錢，之後有冇收據？
say: Can I pay by card when we arrive, and will I get a receipt after?

speaker: ray
text: Yes, card is fine, and the receipt will be emailed after the whole ride ends.
glossYue: 可以，用卡得。成程完咗收據會電郵畀你。
say: Yes, card is fine, and the receipt will be emailed after the whole ride ends.

speaker: gus
text: I'm looking for a short pearl necklace. What's the real difference between freshwater and saltwater pearls?
glossYue: 我想搵一條短珍珠頸鏈。淡水同鹹水珍珠有咩分別？
say: I'm looking for a short pearl necklace. What's the real difference between freshwater and saltwater pearls?

speaker: ida
text: Saltwater pearls have a brighter lustre, so they cost more. Freshwater pearls are softer and much cheaper.
glossYue: 鹹水珍珠光澤更亮，所以貴啲。淡水珍珠軟啲，又平好多。
say: Saltwater pearls have a brighter lustre, so they cost more. Freshwater pearls are softer and much cheaper.

speaker: gus
text: What's the usual price range roughly for these softer freshwater pearls on one short strand please?
glossYue: 呢串軟身淡水珍珠，大概價錢範圍係幾多？
say: What's the usual price range roughly for these softer freshwater pearls on one short strand please?

speaker: ida
text: From two thousand to six thousand dollars, depending on the size and lustre of each freshwater pearl.
glossYue: 大約兩千到六千蚊，視乎每粒淡水珍珠嘅大細同光澤。
say: From two thousand to six thousand dollars, depending on the size and lustre of each freshwater pearl.

speaker: gus
text: I'll take this shorter one. How should I look after the pearl strand back at home?
glossYue: 我要呢條短啲嘅。返到屋企點樣照顧呢串珍珠？
say: I'll take this shorter one. How should I look after the pearl strand back at home?

speaker: ida
text: Put perfume on before you wear it, and wipe the pearl with a soft dry cloth afterwards.
glossYue: 戴之前先噴香水，之後用乾軟布抹乾珍珠。
say: Put perfume on before you wear it, and wipe the pearl with a soft dry cloth afterwards.

speaker: gus
text: Does this shorter strand come with a printed certificate kept inside one small gift box too?
glossYue: 呢條短嘅有冇證書，放喺一個小禮盒入面？
say: Does this shorter strand come with a printed certificate kept inside one small gift box too?

speaker: ida
text: Yes. The certificate is in the box, and it shows both the type and the size.
glossYue: 有。證書喺盒入面，寫明種類同大細。
say: Yes. The certificate is in the box, and it shows both the type and the size.

speaker: tom
text: Hi, I'd like to book a table for eight this Friday at half past seven.
glossYue: 你好，我想訂一張八個人嘅枱，今個星期五七點半。
say: Hi, I'd like to book a table for eight this Friday at half past seven.

speaker: ana
text: Sure. Would you like the private room? There's a minimum spend of three thousand dollars.
glossYue: 可以。要唔要包房？最低消費係三千蚊。
say: Sure. Would you like the private room? There's a minimum spend of three thousand dollars.

speaker: tom
text: That's fine. We'll have a baby with us. Do you have a high chair?
glossYue: 冇問題。我哋會帶個嬰兒。你哋有冇兒童椅？
say: That's fine. We'll have a baby with us. Do you have a high chair?

speaker: ana
text: Yes, I'll put one at the table for you. Do you need a deposit receipt?
glossYue: 有，我會擺一張喺你張枱。你需唔需要訂金收據？
say: Yes, I'll put one at the table for you. Do you need a deposit receipt?

speaker: tom
text: How much is the deposit?
glossYue: 訂金要幾多？
say: How much is the deposit?

speaker: ana
text: It's five hundred dollars. You can pay by card now over the phone.
glossYue: 五百蚊。你可以而家喺電話用卡付。
say: It's five hundred dollars. You can pay by card now over the phone.

speaker: tom
text: Okay. Can you send me a confirmation by text?
glossYue: 好。可唔可以發短訊確認畀我？
say: Okay. Can you send me a confirmation by text?

speaker: ana
text: Of course. What's the best number to reach you?
glossYue: 當然可以。邊個號碼最容易搵到你？
say: Of course. What's the best number to reach you?

speaker: tom
text: The customer is angry because her order arrived a week late. How should I start the reply?
glossYue: 客人好嬲，因為佢嘅貨遲咗一個星期先到。我應該點樣開始回覆？
say: The customer is angry because her order arrived a week late. How should I start the reply?

speaker: ren
text: Start with a sincere apology. Then explain the delay was at our warehouse.
glossYue: 先誠懇道歉。然後解釋延誤係出喺我哋倉庫。
say: Start with a sincere apology. Then explain the delay was at our warehouse.

speaker: tom
text: Should we offer her a full refund?
glossYue: 我哋應唔應該畀佢全額退款？
say: Should we offer her a full refund?

speaker: ren
text: No, offer a partial refund of twenty percent, or store credit if she prefers.
glossYue: 唔好。畀兩成部分退款，或者如果佢想要，就畀店內購物金。
say: No, offer a partial refund of twenty percent, or store credit if she prefers.

speaker: tom
text: Store credit of how much?
glossYue: 購物金幾多？
say: Store credit of how much?

speaker: ren
text: Fifty dollars. Check the amount with me before you send it.
glossYue: 五十蚊。寄出之前同我核對金額。
say: Fifty dollars. Check the amount with me before you send it.

speaker: tom
text: Okay. How should I end the email?
glossYue: 好。電郵應該點樣收尾？
say: Okay. How should I end the email?

speaker: ren
text: Say we'll call her tomorrow to follow up, and thank her for her patience.
glossYue: 話我哋聽日會打電話跟進，並且多謝佢耐心等候。
say: Say we'll call her tomorrow to follow up, and thank her for her patience.

speaker: tom
text: Hi. My first flight was delayed, and I've missed my connection to Tokyo.
glossYue: 你好。我第一班機延誤咗，趕唔切去東京嘅轉機。
say: Hi. My first flight was delayed, and I've missed my connection to Tokyo.

speaker: kim
text: I'm sorry. Let me check. The next flight to Tokyo leaves at nine tonight.
glossYue: 唔好意思。等我查一查。下一班去東京嘅機今晚九點起飛。
say: I'm sorry. Let me check. The next flight to Tokyo leaves at nine tonight.

speaker: tom
text: Can you rebook me on it? And will my checked bag be transferred?
glossYue: 可唔可以幫我改簽上呢班機？我件寄艙行李會唔會轉運？
say: Can you rebook me on it? And will my checked bag be transferred?

speaker: kim
text: Yes, I've rebooked you. Your bag will go on the same flight.
glossYue: 可以，我已經幫你改簽。你件行李會上同一班機。
say: Yes, I've rebooked you. Your bag will go on the same flight.

speaker: tom
text: It's a long wait. Can I get a meal voucher?
glossYue: 等好耐。可唔可以畀張餐券我？
say: It's a long wait. Can I get a meal voucher?

speaker: kim
text: Yes, here's a voucher for thirty dollars. You can use it at any cafe here.
glossYue: 可以，呢張係三十蚊嘅餐券。你喺呢度任何咖啡店都用得。
say: Yes, here's a voucher for thirty dollars. You can use it at any cafe here.

speaker: tom
text: Thanks. Which gate does it leave from?
glossYue: 多謝。佢由邊個閘口起飛？
say: Thanks. Which gate does it leave from?

speaker: kim
text: Gate twenty-two. Here's your new boarding pass.
glossYue: 二十二號閘口。呢張係你嘅新登機證。
say: Gate twenty-two. Here's your new boarding pass.

speaker: cleo
text: Hi. Can I get a latte with oat milk and less sugar, please?
glossYue: 你好。可唔可以畀我一杯燕麥奶少糖嘅拿鐵？
say: Hi. Can I get a latte with oat milk and less sugar, please?

speaker: mira
text: Sure. What size would you like, regular or large?
glossYue: 可以。你要中杯定大杯？
say: Sure. What size would you like, regular or large?

speaker: cleo
text: Regular, please.
glossYue: 中杯，唔該。
say: Regular, please.

speaker: mira
text: For here or to go?
glossYue: 堂食定係拎走？
say: For here or to go?

speaker: cleo
text: To go, please.
glossYue: 拎走，唔該。
say: To go, please.

speaker: mira
text: And what's the name for the order?
glossYue: 訂單個名係咩？
say: And what's the name for the order?

speaker: cleo
text: It's Cleo. Sorry, I think this has regular milk, not oat milk.
glossYue: Cleo。唔好意思，我覺得呢杯係普通奶，唔係燕麥奶。
say: It's Cleo. Sorry, I think this has regular milk, not oat milk.

speaker: mira
text: Oh, I'm so sorry. I'll make you a new one with oat milk right away.
glossYue: 真係唔好意思。我即刻用燕麥奶幫你整過一杯。
say: Oh, I'm so sorry. I'll make you a new one with oat milk right away.

speaker: gus
text: My watch has stopped. Can you change the battery?
glossYue: 我隻錶停咗。可唔可以換電池？
say: My watch has stopped. Can you change the battery?

speaker: ida
text: Sure. It takes about ten minutes, and it's eighty dollars.
glossYue: 可以。大約十分鐘，八十蚊。
say: Sure. It takes about ten minutes, and it's eighty dollars.

speaker: gus
text: Will it still be water resistant after you open the back?
glossYue: 你開咗底之後，仲防唔防水？
say: Will it still be water resistant after you open the back?

speaker: ida
text: Yes, we reseal it and test it. Do you want to keep the metal band?
glossYue: 會，我哋會重新密封同測試。你想留住金屬錶帶嗎？
say: Yes, we reseal it and test it. Do you want to keep the metal band?

speaker: gus
text: It's a bit loose. Can you take out two links?
glossYue: 有啲鬆。可唔可以拆走兩節？
say: It's a bit loose. Can you take out two links?

speaker: ida
text: No problem. That's free with the battery change.
glossYue: 冇問題。連埋換電池一齊做，唔使另收費。
say: No problem. That's free with the battery change.

speaker: gus
text: Great. When can I pick it up?
glossYue: 好。我幾時可以嚟取？
say: Great. When can I pick it up?

speaker: ida
text: Come back at four. The new battery has a one-year warranty.
glossYue: 四點再嚟。新電池有一年保養。
say: Come back at four. The new battery has a one-year warranty.

speaker: tom
text: Hi, I'd like to open an account. What do I need to bring?
glossYue: 你好，我想開戶口。我要帶咩嚟？
say: Hi, I'd like to open an account. What do I need to bring?

speaker: ben
text: Your ID card and a proof of address, like a utility bill from the last three months.
glossYue: 你張身份證，同一份地址證明，例如近三個月嘅水電煤單。
say: Your ID card and a proof of address, like a utility bill from the last three months.

speaker: tom
text: I have both here. Should I open a savings account or a current account?
glossYue: 我兩樣都帶咗。我應該開儲蓄戶口定往來戶口？
say: I have both here. Should I open a savings account or a current account?

speaker: ben
text: For your salary, a savings account is best. It pays a little interest.
glossYue: 出糧嘅話，儲蓄戶口最合適。佢有少少利息。
say: For your salary, a savings account is best. It pays a little interest.

speaker: tom
text: Is there a monthly fee?
glossYue: 有冇月費？
say: Is there a monthly fee?

speaker: ben
text: Only if your balance is under five thousand dollars. Then it's fifty dollars a month.
glossYue: 只有結餘低過五千蚊先至收。咁就每個月五十蚊。
say: Only if your balance is under five thousand dollars. Then it's fifty dollars a month.

speaker: tom
text: When will I get my debit card?
glossYue: 我幾時收到扣帳卡？
say: When will I get my debit card?

speaker: ben
text: It'll arrive by post in five days. You can register for online banking today.
glossYue: 五日之內會郵寄到。你今日可以登記網上銀行。
say: It'll arrive by post in five days. You can register for online banking today.

speaker: wen
text: Good morning, Harbour Clinic. How can I help you?
glossYue: 早晨，海港診所。有咩可以幫到你？
say: Good morning, Harbour Clinic. How can I help you?

speaker: tom
text: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment to see a doctor, please.
glossYue: 你好，我想預約睇醫生。
say: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment to see a doctor, please.

speaker: wen
text: Sure. What are your symptoms?
glossYue: 可以。你有咩症狀？
say: Sure. What are your symptoms?

speaker: tom
text: I've had a sore throat and a fever since yesterday.
glossYue: 我由尋日開始喉嚨痛，仲有發燒。
say: I've had a sore throat and a fever since yesterday.

speaker: wen
text: The earliest appointment is tomorrow at nine thirty with Dr Lam. Is that OK?
glossYue: 最早係聽日九點半，林醫生。可唔可以？
say: The earliest appointment is tomorrow at nine thirty with Dr Lam. Is that OK?

speaker: tom
text: Yes, that's fine. How much is the consultation fee?
glossYue: 可以。診金幾多？
say: Yes, that's fine. How much is the consultation fee?

speaker: wen
text: It's three hundred dollars, including medicine. Please bring your ID card and insurance card, and come ten minutes early.
glossYue: 三百蚊，包藥。請帶身份證同保險卡，提早十分鐘到。
say: It's three hundred dollars, including medicine. Please bring your ID card and insurance card, and come ten minutes early.

speaker: tom
text: Great. Nine thirty tomorrow with Dr Lam. Thank you!
glossYue: 好。聽日九點半，林醫生。多謝！
say: Great. Nine thirty tomorrow with Dr Lam. Thank you!

speaker: tom
text: Hi, I'm checking out of room twelve-oh-eight. Could I get a late checkout until one?
glossYue: 你好，我要退 1208 房。可唔可以延遲退房到一點？
say: Hi, I'm checking out of room twelve-oh-eight. Could I get a late checkout until one?

speaker: kim
text: Sure. A late checkout is forty dollars. Did you take anything from the minibar?
glossYue: 可以。延遲退房四十蚊。你有冇攞迷你吧嘅嘢？
say: Sure. A late checkout is forty dollars. Did you take anything from the minibar?

speaker: tom
text: No, nothing. My flight is at eight tonight. Can you store my luggage until four?
glossYue: 冇。我今晚八點班機。可唔可以幫我存行李到四點？
say: No, nothing. My flight is at eight tonight. Can you store my luggage until four?

speaker: kim
text: Of course. Here's your tag number, fifty-two. Just show it when you come back.
glossYue: 當然可以。你嘅行李牌號碼係五十二。返嚟出示就得。
say: Of course. Here's your tag number, fifty-two. Just show it when you come back.

speaker: tom
text: Thanks. Could you book me a taxi to the airport for four thirty?
glossYue: 多謝。可唔可以幫我訂四點半去機場嘅的士？
say: Thanks. Could you book me a taxi to the airport for four thirty?

speaker: kim
text: No problem. It's about three hundred dollars, and you pay the driver.
glossYue: 冇問題。大約三百蚊，你直接畀錢司機。
say: No problem. It's about three hundred dollars, and you pay the driver.

speaker: tom
text: Great. Could you email me the receipt for the room?
glossYue: 好。可唔可以將房費收據電郵畀我？
say: Great. Could you email me the receipt for the room?

speaker: kim
text: Sure, it's on its way. Have a safe flight!
glossYue: 可以，已經寄出。一路順風！
say: Sure, it's on its way. Have a safe flight!

speaker: tom
text: Hi Nina, do you have a minute? I think my overtime is missing from this month's payslip.
glossYue: 你好 Nina，得唔得閒？我覺得今個月糧單漏咗我嘅加班。
say: Hi Nina, do you have a minute? I think my overtime is missing from this month's payslip.

speaker: nina
text: Let me check. You did twelve hours of overtime in March, right?
glossYue: 等我查。你三月做咗十二個鐘加班，係嗎？
say: Let me check. You did twelve hours of overtime in March, right?

speaker: tom
text: Yes, twelve hours. My manager approved them on the twenty-eighth.
glossYue: 係，十二個鐘。我上司二十八號批咗。
say: Yes, twelve hours. My manager approved them on the twenty-eighth.

speaker: nina
text: I see. That was after the payroll deadline on the twenty-fifth, so they weren't included.
glossYue: 明白。計糧截數日係二十五號，所以嗰啲鐘冇計入。
say: I see. That was after the payroll deadline on the twenty-fifth, so they weren't included.

speaker: tom
text: Oh, OK. Will I get paid for them next month?
glossYue: 哦，好。下個月會唔會出呢筆？
say: Oh, OK. Will I get paid for them next month?

speaker: nina
text: Yes, they'll be on your April payslip. Your tax and MPF will be adjusted too.
glossYue: 會，會出喺你四月嘅糧單。稅同強積金都會一齊調整。
say: Yes, they'll be on your April payslip. Your tax and MPF will be adjusted too.

speaker: tom
text: Great. Could you send me an email to confirm that?
glossYue: 好。可唔可以發封電郵確認？
say: Great. Could you send me an email to confirm that?

speaker: nina
text: Sure, I'll email you this afternoon.
glossYue: 可以，我今日下晝電郵畀你。
say: Sure, I'll email you this afternoon.

speaker: tom
text: Hi. I'd like a cake in a size for ten people, please.
glossYue: 你好。我想要一個夠十個人食嘅蛋糕。
say: Hi. I'd like a cake in a size for ten people, please.

speaker: mira
text: Sure. What flavour would you like, chocolate or mango?
glossYue: 可以。你想要朱古力味定芒果味？
say: Sure. What flavour would you like, chocolate or mango?
